ModuleName: 7 - Object-Oriented Programming and AI-Assisted Coding Workflow

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the module's learning topics across four areas — OOP fundamentals (classes, instances, attributes), modeling engineering objects (Beam and Sensor classes), inheritance and subclasses, and AI-assisted coding tools — serving as a roadmap for learners and instructors to navigate the module's scope and sequence.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: This page lists and briefly describes the major topics covered in Module 7, including OOP fundamentals (classes, objects, attributes, and methods) and AI-assisted coding workflows, giving learners and instructors an overview of what the module covers before diving into individual lessons.

Artifacts.Name: Responsible Use and Verification of AI-Generated Code
Artifacts.Description: This reading explains why AI coding assistants can produce syntactically correct but physically or dimensionally incorrect results, and teaches learners how to critically verify, test, and validate AI-generated code before using it in engineering contexts.

Artifacts.Name: Foundations of Object-Oriented Programming
Artifacts.Description: This reading introduces the core concepts of object-oriented programming—why it was developed, how it differs from procedural programming, and how its principles of encapsulation, abstraction, and modularity benefit engineering and scientific computing.

Artifacts.Name: Modeling Engineering Objects with Classes
Artifacts.Description: This reading demonstrates how to model real-world engineering objects such as beams, sensors, and pumps as Python classes, mapping physical properties to attributes and physical behaviors to methods so learners can apply OOP directly to engineering problems.

Artifacts.Name: Inheritance and Class Hierarchies
Artifacts.Description: This reading explains inheritance and class hierarchies in Python, covering how child classes automatically acquire attributes and methods from parent classes and how to extend or override that behavior to build organized, reusable engineering class structures.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to AI-Assisted Coding Tools
Artifacts.Description: This reading surveys modern AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT, explaining how they work, what kinds of tasks they assist with, and how engineers can integrate them productively into their coding practice.

Artifacts.Name: AI-Assisted Code Generation Workflow
Artifacts.Description: This reading describes a structured workflow for using AI code-generation tools effectively, focusing on how to craft clear prompts, evaluate the output, and iteratively refine AI-generated code to meet engineering requirements.

Artifacts.Name: AI-Assisted Debugging
Artifacts.Description: This reading covers how to use AI assistants as debugging partners, explaining systematic strategies for diagnosing errors, interpreting AI feedback, and correcting faulty code while developing stronger independent debugging skills.
